progression.narrative: The performance opens on G4 and dwells most on G in Ozzal. The line peaks at Bb4 (439.3 Hz) at 0:42.4. It closes on Fk4, not the tonic (Bb4 → Gs4 → Gs4 → Ek4 → Ek4 → Fk4).
